title: Repeat-Dispute Leaderboard
note: resrisk-v2 · resdb-v2 · flags-v2 · cat-v1 · A market appears here when its UMA status sequence contains 'disputed' at least 2 times. Ranked by volume, not by dispute count: 340 markets tie on 2 and 3 disputes, so a count sort is an arbitrary order wearing a ranking's clothes. Outcome is the final UMA state — where the contract ended up, not a judgement on whether the dispute was right. Dispute counts are Polymarket/UMA only, on the 58,623 markets that carry a UMA status sequence — Gamma populates it from 2025 onward. Kalshi exposes disputes as a transient market state with no retrospective filter, so its count here is a floor of zero, not a measurement of zero.
